project_type: Node.js Express REST API - OnCall AI Agent Control Plane
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install deps. 2. Run npm start and verify server starts. 3. Run npm test to verify all tests pass. 4. Test a few endpoints with curl.
setup_instructions: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/testing-prod && npm install
environment_constraints: Node.js available via nvm (v22.22.3). Must source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh before using node/npm. Open internet - can install npm packages freely.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project. Single commit with all files at the end.
key_patterns: Express.js REST API with modular route files, Bearer token auth middleware, in-memory data store, realistic mock responses.
directory_structure: Greenfield - to be created with: src/ (main source), src/routes/ (route handlers by domain), src/middleware/ (auth, error handling), src/data/ (in-memory stores and mock data)
